description:
You are a data journalist covering the 2024 election money race. Research the 2023-2024 election cycle financial summaries for three specific Super PACs on the Federal Election Commission (FEC) website (https://www.fec.gov). 

The target committees are:
1. Make America Great Again Inc. (The primary pro-Trump Super PAC)
2. Future Forward USA PAC (The primary pro-Biden/Harris Hybrid PAC)
3. Senate Leadership Fund (The primary GOP Senate Super PAC)

For each committee, extract the following data for the 2023-2024 cycle:
- Committee ID (starts with C)
- Total Receipts
- Total Independent Expenditures
- Ending Cash on Hand
- Coverage Through Date (the end date of the reporting period)

Create a Firefox bookmark folder named 'FEC Research' containing the FEC profile page for each of these three committees.

Save your findings to a JSON file at ~/Documents/super_pac_financials.json with keys 'make_america_great_again_inc', 'future_forward_usa_pac', and 'senate_leadership_fund'.
